issues.title: Grass tufts render into the planar reflection as confetti on water
issues.detail: Tuft InstancedMesh is on the TERRAIN layer the reflection camera includes, and its distance fade uses cameraPosition (mirrored camera is under the water, so nothing fades). Yellow/orange speckle covers every river and the estuary. Hide S.grass.mesh in the onReflection(true) callback or put tufts on a layer reflCam disables.

issues.title: Aerial frames washed-out and relief-free
issues.detail: aerial_12 luminance std 8.8, p5-p95 118-146: no readable relief or shadow at 500 m. Fog already ~30% at 500-700 m, albedo pulled to luminance (mix(lum,c,0.45), min(c,0.62)), flat plains never self-shadow, cavity AO too weak. Coordinate a haze curve with environment that keeps <800 m clear, restore albedo contrast/saturation, add real 20 m / 200 m macro variation (dirt patches, worn paths, meadow vs pasture), add curvature/slope darkening.

issues.title: Street-level ground is programmer art (sprite tufts on a smeared ground)
issues.detail: Three identical 3-quad tuft variants on a 3 m jittered grid, uniform scale, no shadows/AO, hard 140 m radius with pale blobs at the fade edge; fine ground layer barely visible. Needs dense blade geometry near the camera with size/hue variation and dithered fade, a visible high-frequency ground layer, and ground-contact darkening.

issues.title: Night tufts are self-lit against a dark ground
issues.detail: instanceColor x bright blade atlas with an upward normal vs ground at L~23 makes the sprites glow. Derive tuft albedo from the ground tint at that point, use the ground normal, let the night exposure drive them.

issues.title: Spire peak, smooth-cone islands/hills, abrupt rock-to-grass skirt, speckle-aliased rock
issues.detail: Main ridge ends in one aliased witch-hat spire; island and outlying hills are featureless cones; rock meets grass in a hard line; distant rock shows dark speckle noise. Clamp/soften ridged pow peaks, add secondary ridges and talus, blend rock->scree->grass over 30-60 m with slope noise, fade rock detail normals with distance.

issues.title: Uniform pinkish sand ribbon around every water body
issues.detail: Constant width, hard edge, pink tint; at night the wet/foam line is a white outline. Vary beach width by slope and noise, tint grey-tan, mix shingle/mud/reed edges, soften the wet line.

issues.title: Blocky, stair-stepped terrain shadows
issues.detail: Shadows are cast by the 8 m / 16 m LOD proxies (plus uLodDrop) rather than the 4 m heightfield, so valley-wall shadows step and blob. Cast from LOD0 (or a 4 m proxy) in cascade 0 and soften with PCF.

issues.title: Brush-stroke swirl repetition of the coarse grass layer at aerial scale
issues.detail: The warped-UV coarse layer produces a recognisable curved-stroke motif across the whole plain. Lower warp amplitude, add a third rotated sample or stochastic tiling, break with macro variation.

issues.title: Water reflections weak and incomplete
issues.detail: No visible ridge reflection at noon, no moon glint at 22, reflection lacks clouds/sun disc because the environment sky dome only follows the main camera (already filed in docs/core-requests/terrain.md). Raise reflection strength/Fresnel floor at grazing angles.

issues.title: Valley preset has no valley
issues.detail: River is a -7.5 m channel with a 22 m shore lerp cut into a near-flat floodplain; the showcase preset oversells it. Acceptable for buildability; frame the preset from lower on the valley wall or add gentle terraces.

issues.title: Tooling/core (not scored): boot overlay leak and 30 s screenshot timeout
issues.detail: #boot 0.6 s opacity fade leaked into the first coast_22 capture under SwiftShader starvation although __sim.ready was true; tools/screenshot.mjs hard-codes a 30 s page.screenshot timeout so 10/16 gauntlet shots died under 3-critic contention. Hide the overlay without a transition in headless mode; expose a --shotTimeout flag.

strengths: Zero console errors and status ready in every shot; 11-16 draw calls vs budget 20; max 255,248 triangles vs budget 900,000.

API contract complete and correct: getHeight/getNormal/getSlope/isWater/raycast verified in-page; heights Float32Array 513x513; modify raises 12 m, bumps version, emits terrain:changed and visibly updates the mesh; fully deterministic (no Math.random).
Instanced R32F-height chunk/LOD/skirt/proxy architecture is right and cheap; edits are a texture upload.
Heightfield generator delivers eroded ridges, a meandering river, estuary, island and coast, and exposes them via world.terrain.features for roads/democity.
Golden-hour skylines (6.5 and 17.5) are genuinely good: long soft shadows, straw-dry grass tint, sea glint - keep the palette.
Water fundamentals work: planar reflection (island reflects), shore transparency, depth tint, foam band, wet-shoreline darkening and underwater tint.
summary: Clean engineering (0 errors, 16/20 draws, API contract OK, deterministic) but the look is a 6: washed-out relief-free aerials (std 8.8), sprite tufts on a smeared ground at street level, self-lit tufts at night, spire/cone mountains, a uniform pink shore ribbon, and a blocker bug where the grass tufts are reflected in every river as confetti. Fix the reflection leak, the haze/contrast/macro-variation of the plains, and replace the tuft sprites before the next round.
